description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git status' and related commands in a project involving multiple submodules. It contains test functions, setup routines, and test cases to verify the behavior of git status in various scenarios with submodules, including handling of untracked and modified files, merge conflicts, nested submodules, and commit states.

methods.name: test_create_repo_with_commit
methods.description: Creates a new repository at a given path with an initial commit containing a 'bar' and a 'foo' file.

methods.name: sanitize_output
methods.description: Cleans up git output by replacing commit hashes with a placeholder.

methods.name: sanitize_diff
methods.description: Removes specific diff lines related to index SHA-1s for comparison purposes.
